message: I'm also still in the process of working my way through Elbow's essay, but was anxious to jump in at the end of yr post. I'm curious about the "teach-ability" of style. What exactly would that mean, or look like?  How does a writer develop a style? Can one guide a student towards his/her "natural" style, and what are the ethical implications of that process? Wouldn't it be necessary to have some evaluation scheme/ranking system in place? (Did you happen to read Ben Yagoda's book of a few years ago on style? Very thought provoking...)
